"""Build a canonical ZIP archive from a JSON request on stdin."""
import base64
import hashlib
import io
import json
import sys
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime


def _is_int(x):
    return isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool)


def _valid_path(p):
    if not isinstance(p, str) or not p:
        return False
    if "\\" in p:
        return False
    for comp in p.split("/"):
        if comp in ("", ".", ".."):
            return False
    return True


def _decode_b64(s):
    if not isinstance(s, str):
        return None
    try:
        data = base64.b64decode(s, validate=True)
    except Exception:
        return None
    if len(data) > 65536:
        return None
    return data


def _build(req):
    if not isinstance(req, dict) or set(req) != {"members", "timestamp", "comment"}:
        return None
    members = req["members"]
    if not isinstance(members, list) or not 1 <= len(members) <= 64:
        return None
    seen = set()
    entries = []
    for m in members:
        if not isinstance(m, dict) or set(m) != {"path", "content_b64", "mode"}:
            return None
        p = m["path"]
        if not _valid_path(p) or p in seen:
            return None
        seen.add(p)
        data = _decode_b64(m["content_b64"])
        if data is None:
            return None
        mode = m["mode"]
        if not _is_int(mode) or not 0 <= mode <= 511:
            return None
        entries.append((p, data, mode))
    ts = req["timestamp"]
    if not isinstance(ts, list) or len(ts) != 6 or not all(_is_int(x) for x in ts):
        return None
    year, month, day, hour, minute, second = ts
    if not 1980 <= year <= 2107 or second % 2 != 0:
        return None
    try:
        datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, second)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    comment = req["comment"]
    if not isinstance(comment, str) or len(comment) > 200:
        return None
    entries.sort(key=lambda e: e[0])
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    zf = zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
    dt = (year, month, day, hour, minute, second)
    for p, data, mode in entries:
        zi = zipfile.ZipInfo(filename=p, date_time=dt)
        zi.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        zi.create_system = 3
        zi.external_attr = (0o100000 | mode) << 16
        try:
            p.encode("ascii")
        except UnicodeEncodeError:
            zi.flag_bits |= 0x0800
        zf.writestr(zi, data)
    zf.comment = comment.encode("utf-8")
    zf.close()
    return buf.getvalue()


def main():
    try:
        raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        req = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        req = None
    try:
        archive = _build(req)
    except Exception:
        archive = None
    if archive is None:
        sys.stdout.write('{"error":"invalid_request"}')
        return
    result = {
        "format": "zip",
        "archive_b64": base64.b64encode(archive).decode("ascii"),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest(),
    }
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":")))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

members = [
    {"path": "z.txt", "content_b64": base64.b64encode(b"z").decode(), "mode": 511},
    {"path": "a/b/c.txt", "content_b64": "", "mode": 0},
    {"path": "\u00fcber/\u0444\u0430\u0439\u043b.txt", "content_b64": base64.b64encode("h\u00e9llo".encode()).decode(), "mode": 493},
]
cmt = "ünïcode ✓ " * 20
req2 = {"members": members, "timestamp": [1980, 12, 31, 23, 59, 58], "comment": cmt}
out = run_obj(req2)
res = json.loads(out)
data = base64.b64decode(res["archive_b64"])
zf = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
assert zf.namelist() == sorted(["z.txt", "a/b/c.txt", "\u00fcber/\u0444\u0430\u0439\u043b.txt"]), zf.namelist()
for n, mode in [("z.txt", 511), ("a/b/c.txt", 0), ("\u00fcber/\u0444\u0430\u0439\u043b.txt", 493)]:
    zi = zf.getinfo(n)
    assert zi.compress_type == 8
    assert zi.date_time == (1980, 12, 31, 23, 59, 58)
    assert zi.create_system == 3
    assert zi.external_attr == ((0o100000 | mode) << 16)
assert zf.read("a/b/c.txt") == b""
assert zf.read("\u00fcber/\u0444\u0430\u0439\u043b.txt") == "h\u00e9llo".encode()
assert zf.comment == cmt.encode()
assert zf.testzip() is None
assert run_obj(req2) == out
print("multi ok")
